name: superdoc-word-addin-starter
description: Real-time document sync between Microsoft Word and a web-based SuperDoc editor

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../webapp && npm install && cd ../addin && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,addin,webapp,word -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run server" "npm run addin:dev" "npm run webapp" "sleep 3 && npm run addin:start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,addin,webapp -c blue,green,magenta "npm run server" "npm run addin:dev" "npm run webapp"
